list_products.name: list_products
list_products.description: Retrieve a list of all products

aiMetadata.description: Lists products in a Lightfunnels store, with optional pagination (limit/cursor) and a Lightfunnels query string to filter, sort, and scope results (e.g. "order_by:id order_dir:desc"); an empty query returns all products in default order. Use to browse the catalog or find products by criteria. Read-only and idempotent.

get_product.name: get_product
get_product.description: Retrieve a specific product by ID

productId.description: The ID of the product to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single Lightfunnels product by its node ID, including variants, options, pricing, and related funnels/stores. Use when you already have a product ID and need its complete record; use List Products first if you only have a name or other criteria. Read-only and idempotent.

options.description: Product options like size, color, etc.
Option values for this variant (array of objects with id and value pairs)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new product in Lightfunnels with a title, price, and required options and variants arrays (each variant maps option values). Use to add a catalog item; not for updating an existing product. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate product even with identical input.

get_order.name: get_order
get_order.description: Retrieve a specific order by ID

orderId.description: The ID of the order to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single Lightfunnels order by its node ID, including line items, payments, refunds, customer, and shipping/billing addresses. Use when you have an order ID and need its complete record; use List Orders first if you only have other criteria. Read-only and idempotent.

Lists orders in a Lightfunnels store, with optional pagination (limit/cursor) and a Lightfunnels query string to filter, sort, and scope results (e.g. "order_by:created_at order_dir:desc"); an empty query returns all orders in default order. Use to browse orders or find them by criteria. Read-only and idempotent.

orderId.description: The ID of the order to cancel

aiMetadata.description: Cancels a Lightfunnels order by ID with a required reason, optionally notifying the customer and/or issuing a refund. Use to void an order; the order ID must reference an existing, cancellable order. Mutating and not idempotent — refund/notification side effects may recur if re-invoked on an already-cancelled order.

phone.description: Phone number of the customer eg: +1234567890

acceptsMarketing.description: Whether the customer accepts marketing communications

tags.description: Tags to associate with the customer

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new customer record in Lightfunnels with first/last name, email, phone, marketing-consent flag, and tags. Use to add a contact; not for updating an existing customer. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate customer even with identical input.

get_customer.name: get_customer
get_customer.description: Retrieve a specific customer by ID

customerId.description: The ID of the customer to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Lightfunnels customer by its node ID, including contact details, location, order count, and expenses. Use when you have a customer ID and need their record; use List Customers first if you only have other criteria. Read-only and idempotent.

Lists customers in a Lightfunnels store, with optional pagination (limit/cursor) and a Lightfunnels query string to filter, sort, and scope results (e.g. "order_by:created_at order_dir:desc"); an empty query returns all customers in default order. Use to browse contacts or find them by criteria. Read-only and idempotent.

get_funnel.name: get_funnel
get_funnel.description: Retrieve a specific funnel by ID

funnelId.description: The ID of the funnel to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Lightfunnels funnel by its node ID, returning its name, slug, and published status. Use when you have a funnel ID and need its record. Read-only and idempotent.

new_order.name: new_order
new_order.description: Triggers when a new order is created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an order is confirmed in Lightfunnels (the order/confirmed webhook event), emitting the new order record. Use to react to incoming sales such as fulfillment, notifications, or downstream sync.

new_lead.name: new_lead
new_lead.description: Triggers when a new lead subscribes

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new lead signs up in Lightfunnels (the contact/signup webhook event), emitting the new customer/contact record. Use to react to newly captured leads such as CRM sync, welcome emails, or list enrollment.
